locations.note: The squadron helps defend the Allied forces at Dunkirk in 1940.
The Battle of Britain, dogfights over London against a German ace.
A reconnaissance mission over German positions in the Libyan desert, then cover for a British assault.
The squadron helps repel the Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor.
The squadron destroys a Japanese convoy that includes a carrier.
The squadron defends Midway and covers the bombers that destroy a large Japanese fleet.
The squadron beats off Japanese landings and destroys a Japanese battleship.
US landings are supported, and tanks and bunkers are destroyed.
The squadron covers the bombers over Rabaul, then wrecks the rest of the Japanese base.
A strike on German shipping in Norway and a secret German heavy water base found through a fjord passage.
Covering the D-Day landings from the air, where Joe is shot down and killed.
Ground support during the liberation of Paris.
Swarms of Luftwaffe fighters over the Ardennes in the Battle of the Bulge.
The final mission over Berlin in 1945 against the German jet fighters of the Nowotny squadron, led by the ace from London, who is shot down.
